title: Verify: HeaderOverlay store-wired controls unit tests
summary: Unit tests for sound and settings against the real store
description: Write unit tests from REQ2 using the real uiStore.
acceptance_criteria: Both control tests pass against the real store

steps.action: Create describe 'HeaderOverlay controls' with beforeEach resetting the store. Test 'sound button toggles soundEnabled': render with roundFixture (from ./fixtures/api, mirroring Round in src/api/client.ts), click getByRole('button',{name:'Toggle sound'}), assert useUiStore.getState().soundEnabled false and aria-pressed 'false'. Test 'settings button opens settings': click getByRole('button',{name:'Settings'}), assert settingsOpen true.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/headerOverlayControls.test.tsx
